types.name: widgets.Axis
types.doc: How the panes are laid out: `.horizontal` side by side, `.vertical` stacked.

types.name: widgets.Column
types.doc: One column: its label, its width, and the narrowest it resizes to.

types.name: widgets.ColumnSort
types.doc: The sorted column and its direction.

types.name: widgets.MenuChoice
types.doc: The item a bar's menu chose.

types.name: widgets.NumberFormat
types.doc: How a value is shown: `decimals` (at most `decimals_max`) digits after the point, then `unit` (at most `unit_cap` bytes, app-owned).

types.name: widgets.Paint
types.doc: Fill and corner radius copied onto each instance a widget appends.

types.name: widgets.WindowButton
types.doc: One of the window buttons, in drawing order.

tags.name: maximize
tags.doc: Maximize, drawn as restore while the window is maximized.

constants.name: widgets.kit.hover_lighten
constants.doc: The dark scheme's shader mix toward white at animator value 1.

constants.name: widgets.kit.down_darken
constants.doc: The dark scheme's shader mix toward black at animator value 1, applied after the lighten.

constants.name: widgets.kit.accent_radius
constants.doc: The corner radius of an accent `Paint`: the knob ring's stroke, which `knob.zig` asserts.

constants.name: widgets.kit.hover_duration_ms
constants.doc: Wall time for hover to travel the unit range.

constants.name: widgets.kit.down_duration_ms
constants.doc: Wall time for the press darken to travel the unit range.

constants.name: widgets.kit.hover_rate_per_ms
constants.doc: Fraction of the unit range covered in one millisecond of hover.

constants.name: widgets.kit.down_rate_per_ms
constants.doc: Fraction of the unit range covered in one millisecond of press.

constants.name: widgets.kit.name_style
constants.doc: The dark scheme's control names beside a ring, meter, or pill.

constants.name: widgets.kit.value_style
constants.doc: The dark scheme's knob value readouts: monospace, so the digits do not shift as the value changes.

constants.name: widgets.kit.centered
constants.doc: Text centered on both axes, without an ellipsis.

functions.name: widgets.kit.paint_of
functions.doc: `color` as a widget's paint, with `radius` for the faces it rounds.

functions.name: widgets.kit.accent
functions.doc: The app scheme's accent `index` (cycled modulo `theme.accent_count`) as a paint with `accent_radius`, for an app that wants its knob accents to follow the theme.

functions.name: widgets.kit.settled
functions.doc: An animator resting at 0, or at 1 when `at_end`.

functions.name: widgets.kit.append
functions.doc: Appends `record` of draw type `T` (sampling `texture`, null for an untextured type) through the UI context `cx`, skipping it when its pool or the batch list is full; the context counts the drop (section 2).

functions.name: widgets.kit.face
functions.doc: A `draw.Box` over `rect` under `clip`; nothing when `rect` has a non-positive edge.

functions.name: widgets.kit.surface
functions.doc: A `draw.Surface` whose shape is `rect`, under `clip` (`draw/types.zig`, section 6).

functions.name: widgets.kit.lit
functions.doc: `look` at the animator values `hover` and `down`: its fill, end stop, and border mixed toward `scheme.colors.lighten` and then `darken` by the scheme's weights, as `Box`'s shader mixes (section 3).

functions.name: widgets.kit.backdrop
functions.doc: Marks `layer` as a backdrop with `material`'s blur (section 4) and returns the id glass on it samples; null when the app registers no `draw.Glass` or `material` is solid.

functions.name: widgets.kit.glass
functions.doc: A `draw.Glass` over `rect` under `clip`, sampling the highest backdrop at or below the current layer (section 4).

functions.name: widgets.kit.has
functions.doc: True when the UI context type `Cx` (a pointer to it) draws through a registry that has the draw type `T`: a skin's optional parts (`glass`, `stroke`) ask it at compile time.

functions.name: widgets.kit.stroke
functions.doc: A stroke through `points` (absolute, at least two) in `color`, `width` wide with round caps, under `clip` (`draw.path.polyline`).

functions.name: widgets.kit.chevron_points
functions.doc: The three points of a chevron centred on `centre`, `half` from it along its axis: a "›" rotated by `turn` quarter turns clockwise, so 0 points right and 1 points down.

functions.name: widgets.kit.chevron
functions.doc: A chevron (`chevron_points`) stroked `chevron_width` wide in `color` under `clip`; false, with nothing appended, without `draw.Path` (`stroke`), so a skin draws a glyph instead.

functions.name: widgets.kit.is_space
functions.doc: True when `press` is Space without modifiers: no host names the key, so it arrives as `other` typing one space.

functions.name: widgets.kit.bevel_of
functions.doc: The bevel of a glass face of `radius`: the radius, between 6 and 16 logical pixels.

functions.name: widgets.kit.glass_look
functions.doc: The glass look `material` gives a face of `radius` in `scheme` (section 4).

functions.name: widgets.kit.glass_face
functions.doc: A translucent face for a control inside glass (section 4): `colors.track` at `0.25 + 0.5 tint` alpha, a one-pixel `colors.lighten` border at `rim / 2` alpha, and the hover weight.

functions.name: widgets.kit.arc
functions.doc: A `draw.Arc` inscribed in the square `ring` under `clip`.

functions.name: widgets.kit.label
functions.doc: `bytes` in `style`, placed in `rect` by `options` under `clip`.

functions.name: widgets.kit.paragraph
functions.doc: `bytes` in `style`, wrapped to `rect.width` and placed by `options` under `clip` (`text.place_wrapped`): `label`'s twin for text longer than a line.

functions.name: widgets.kit.icon
functions.doc: `codepoint` of `face` at `size`, its ink centred on `rect` under `clip` (`text.icon`): an icon from an app's icon face.

functions.name: widgets.kit.step
functions.doc: Steps `value` by `dt_ms`: a moved value owes a redraw and a live one another frame.

functions.name: widgets.kit.aim
functions.doc: Aims `value` at `target`; a new target owes a redraw.

functions.name: widgets.kit.weight
functions.doc: The shader mix weight of animator value `amount`: `amount * scale`.

functions.name: widgets.kit.clicked
functions.doc: True when `event` releases a press of area `id` over it: a clickable row.

functions.name: widgets.kit.respond
functions.doc: Aims `hover` and `down` (null for a widget without a press channel) from one hit, by the table in section 3.

widgets.name: widgets.Label
widgets.doc: Text centered in its box, in `style`.

widgets.name: widgets.Paragraph
widgets.doc: Text wrapped to its box's width, in `style`.

widgets.name: widgets.Panel
widgets.doc: The default panel: `PanelOf(skins.Default)`, a rounded face.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: The panel's material; null takes the scheme's (`theme.zig`, section 7).

widgets.name: widgets.Button
widgets.doc: The default button: `ButtonOf(skins.Default)`, a face with a centered label.

widgets.name: widgets.Slider
widgets.doc: The default slider: `SliderOf(skins.Default)`, a capsule track with a disc knob.

widgets.name: widgets.Knob
widgets.doc: The default knob: `KnobOf(skins.Default)`, an open ring with its labels.

actions.name: reset
actions.doc: A right press set the value back to `default`.

widgets.name: widgets.Meter
widgets.doc: The default meter: `MeterOf(skins.Default)`, a capsule level column.

fields.name: track_h
fields.doc: The track's height in logical pixels (section 1).

widgets.name: widgets.Toggle
widgets.doc: The default toggle: `ToggleOf(skins.Default)`, a pill with a sliding thumb.

actions.name: committed
actions.doc: Enter, or focus moved away (a press elsewhere or Tab).

actions.name: cancelled
actions.doc: Escape.

actions.name: chosen
actions.doc: The item at this index was chosen; the menu closed.

actions.name: dismissed
actions.doc: The menu closed without a choice.

actions.name: chosen
actions.doc: The item at this index was chosen; the menu closed.

actions.name: dismissed
actions.doc: The menu closed without a choice.

actions.name: changed
actions.doc: The selected item changed to this index.

actions.name: moved
actions.doc: The divider moved; the new ratio.

actions.name: reset
actions.doc: A double click restored `default`.

actions.name: changed
actions.doc: A different tab was selected; its index.

actions.name: closed
actions.doc: The tab was closed; the app removes it (section 3c).

actions.name: moved
actions.doc: The tab moved within the bar; the app moves it (`move_item`).

actions.name: dragged_out
actions.doc: The tab was dropped on another drag target; the app removes it.

actions.name: received
actions.doc: A drag carrying `payload` was dropped at `index`; the app inserts the tab.

widgets.name: widgets.Segmented
widgets.doc: A segmented control: tabs arranged `even` in a track, drawn with `bar` (no page).

actions.name: changed
actions.doc: A different tab was selected; its index.

actions.name: closed
actions.doc: The tab was closed; the app removes it (section 3c).

actions.name: moved
actions.doc: The tab moved within the bar; the app moves it (`move_item`).

actions.name: dragged_out
actions.doc: The tab was dropped on another drag target; the app removes it.

actions.name: received
actions.doc: A drag carrying `payload` was dropped at `index`; the app inserts the tab.

actions.name: activated
actions.doc: A tab was selected: its panel.

actions.name: closed
actions.doc: A panel left the layout.

actions.name: moved
actions.doc: A panel moved within its set or to another place.

actions.name: resized
actions.doc: A divider moved.

actions.name: selected
actions.doc: A click or a key selected this row.

actions.name: activated
actions.doc: A double click or Enter activated this row.

actions.name: pressed
actions.doc: The button was clicked; its request is made.

actions.name: opened
actions.doc: This title's menu opened (a press, a switch by hover, or Left / Right).

actions.name: closed
actions.doc: The open menu closed without a choice.

actions.name: changed
actions.doc: A drag, the wheel, or a reset changed the value.

actions.name: committed
actions.doc: A typed value was entered.
